## Task Launcher 0.2.0

Each started issue now lists its agent sessions the way Orca's sidebar does, and the panel opens instantly.

- A started issue shows its sessions with the agent icon and the session name exactly as Orca shows it. A green dot marks a session while its agent is working.
- Pressing a session's terminal or chat button opens its worktree and, on macOS, brings its tab to the front.
- The worktree and branch show under the sessions. When they share a name, one line shows both.
- The panel opens with the last project's issues straight away, and board fields fill in when GitHub Projects answers. A slow or failing board no longer holds up the list.
- The panel follows project switches that Orca reports without a workspace event.

No new plugin capabilities. Updates install without re-approval.
